meta.title: Image Pathify
meta.description: Lets text-only models handle pasted chat images, with a native vision experience, batch image viewing, and a built-in OpenAI-compatible analyze_image tool; vision-capable models are unaffected.

en.apiKeyHint: Stored outside the settings file. Leave blank to keep the current key.
en.apiKeyUnset: No key is configured; vision is unavailable until one is.
en.disableThinkingOffHint: Thinking consumes the output budget. Raise the cap, or set it to 0 to omit max_tokens.
en.maxTokensHint: Vision model output cap. Set 0 to omit max_tokens. Raise this if the response is truncated.
en.modelsEmpty: Every text-only model is currently admitted.
en.relaxAdmissionHint: Turn off to reject pasted images by model capability.
en.saveFailed: Save failed. Your edits were kept — check them and try again.
en.visionBaseUrlHint: Default is https://api.deepseek.com. Any OpenAI-compatible URL (some addresses need /v1 appended).
en.visionModelHint: Default is deepseek-flash. You can also use Qwen, GLM, or other OpenAI-compatible vision models.
